disease_label_per_paper: Sarcoidosis presenting with severe hypercalcemia and acute renal failure
presentation_summary: 56-year-old man admitted repeatedly over 3 months for recurrent abdominal pain with nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, thirst and polyuria.
He had persistent hypercalcemia and renal insufficiency with peak calcium 13.5 mg/dL, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D 69 and ACE 98 U/L.
Chest X-ray was normal but CT chest revealed subtle mediastinal adenopathy; subsequent biopsy confirmed sarcoidosis.
